title: Yub-Nub Explorer — Endor Space, 1979
description: A timber-ribbed Galaxy Explorer with a Wicket-orange command hood, round ear scanners, twin yellow cockpits, leaf-pattern solar wings, an expedition deck and four Ewok astronauts. Grey, blue and yellow Classic Space meets Endor engineering throughout the spacecraft.

sections.name: Wicket command cabin and ear scanners
Twin retro rocket pods and leaf fins
